_note: Measured history from /api/v1/area/{slug}/series (metric=P1|P2, period=24h|7d|30d). Captured once and stored: the API sends no CORS header, so a browser cannot read it from this kit at runtime. Coverage is partial — the endpoint rate-limits on the number of DISTINCT areas one client asks for ('Too many different areas requested'), which is the same anti-enumeration posture as the map tiers. A slug that is absent here has not been captured yet; it is not a place without history.
